name: Warba Bank
founded: 2010 (incorporated 17 Feb 2010 by Amiri Decree No. 289/2009; registered with CBK as an Islamic bank on 7 Apr 2010)
regulators: CMA Kuwait (investment management: fund management, discretionary and non-discretionary portfolio management, custody)
ownership_summary: Kuwaiti public shareholding company listed on Boursa Kuwait. Current shareholder percentages were not found: the IR factsheet loads dynamically and was not readable. The Kuwait Investment Authority appoints at least one board member (Mishari F. AlMusallam, from 27 Mar 2025, per the FY2025 annual report). Since 8 Apr 2025 Warba has owned Warba Strategy Company S.P.C., which holds 32.75% of Gulf Bank K.S.C.P. A potential merger into a single Sharia-compliant bank is under study: CBK acknowledged it on 15 Jun 2025, and Gulf Bank said on 24 May 2026 that due diligence was nearing completion.
government_link: Yes - the Kuwait Investment Authority appoints at least one board member (Mishari F. AlMusallam, KIA investment manager, appointed by KIA from 27 Mar 2025). The KIA stake percentage was not verified in B25.
group_structure: Warba Bank K.S.C.P. consolidates its wholly owned subsidiary Warba Strategy Company S.P.C. (formerly Al Ghanem Trading Company W.L.L., acquired 8 Apr 2025 for KWD 498.2m, incl. assumed debt of KWD 267.3m) and SPVs. Warba Strategy holds 32.75% of Boursa-listed Gulf Bank K.S.C.P., which is equity-accounted as an associate (carrying amount KWD 508.5m at 30 Jun 2026). Joint ventures are carried at KWD 127.3m. Investment management (Warba Investment Management / Warba Asset Management) is a department of the bank, not a separate legal entity. DOUBLE COUNTING: Warba's total assets include only the equity-accounted Gulf Bank stake, not Gulf Bank's balance sheet. If Gulf Bank is profiled, do not add any share of its assets or deposits to Warba. If the merger proceeds, the combined entity would replace both.

footprint: Kuwait only. 21 branches at end-2025 after opening Shamiya and Saad Al-Abdullah, with 154+ ATMs (FY2025 annual report). Royal Banking is served at dedicated branches (Al-Rayah Tower, Kaifan, Adaliya, Avenues, Salmiya, Jaber Al-Ali, Jaber Al-Ahmad). Head office: Al-Raya Tower, Omar Ibn Al-Khattab Street, Kuwait City.
customer_segments: Retail (incl. youth 'Wave Banking' and the SiDi digital wallet for migrant workers), Royal Banking (upper affluent), Private Banking, SME ('Beyond' business banking), corporate, and investment-management clients (corporate and retail).
business_lines: Islamic retail banking (financing, cards, savings), corporate banking, treasury, investment banking (structured and securitisation finance, syndication, debt capital markets / sukuk, financial institutions) and investment management. Investment management has two departments: Portfolio & Fund Management (discretionary mandates and funds incl. Islamic money market funds, an Islamic income/private credit fund, equipment leasing and real estate funds) and Fiduciary Services (non-discretionary portfolio management and custody), plus real estate and direct investment teams.

capabilities.wealth_summary: Warba is a fully Islamic Kuwaiti bank. Its wealth offer is split between relationship segments and an in-house investment management unit. Royal Banking (upper affluent: KD 2,500 monthly salary or KD 100k-400k balance, dedicated branches) and Private Banking (dedicated RM, personalised investment solutions, Shariah-compliant money market funds) sit under personal banking. In 2025 the retail group marketed Shariah-compliant funds and sukuk to these clients. Warba Investment Management (Portfolio & Fund Management, Fiduciary Services, Real Estate, Direct Investments) offers open- and closed-ended funds (KWD/USD Islamic money market funds; a second series of its Islamic income fund, launched 2025, providing senior-secured financing to US/European mid-market companies; equipment leasing and real estate funds), discretionary and non-discretionary portfolio management and custody. It reported ~KWD 715m AUM at end-2025, which includes non-discretionary and custody assets, and fiduciary assets reached KWD 860.5m at 30 Jun 2026. A digital trading platform for local, regional and international markets is listed as 'Coming Soon'. The AI tools Warba Advisor (2024, recommendations incl. investments) and Bdr AI (in-app agentic assistant, Jul 2026) show a strong AI and digital push.

asset_management.detail: Warba Investment Management / Warba Asset Management (bank department; Head of Portfolio & Fund Management Walid Achour). Funds: open-ended Islamic money market funds (KWD, USD); flagship Islamic income fund (2nd series launched 2025; private credit to US/European mid-market companies); equipment leasing and real estate funds. AUM ~KWD 715m (USD 2.34bn) at 31 Dec 2025 incl. non-discretionary and custody.

brokerage.detail: No brokerage subsidiary or licence found. Non-discretionary portfolio management executes client instructions with market access (CMA-regulated). A 'Trading Solutions (Coming Soon)' digital trading platform is announced. The fiduciary head's bio refers to online trading.

digital_investing.detail: As of 12 Oct 2026 the investment management page lists 'Trading Solutions (Coming Soon) - a digital trading platform providing clients with direct access to local, regional, and international markets'. The Warba mobile app's documented features are banking. Warba Advisor (2024) gives AI recommendations on accounts, cards, savings and investments; Bdr AI (Jul 2026) handles supported transactions.

advisory.detail: Private Banking 'personalized investment solutions' with expert guidance (S6); Warba Advisor AI service offering recommendations including investments (S9).

discretionary.detail: Discretionary portfolio management on agreed mandates under Kuwait CMA rules (Portfolio & Fund Management Department).

model_portfolios_robo.detail: No model portfolio or robo-advice product found; Warba Advisor is an AI recommendation tool, not a managed robo portfolio.

funds_platform.detail: In-house funds are documented. The 2025 annual report says the bank 'marketed a range of investment funds and sukuk' to Private and Royal Banking clients without saying whether third-party funds were included. No fund platform provider named.

structured_products.detail: The 'structured products' page under investment banking covers corporate structured and securitisation finance, not investor products.

private_markets.detail: Islamic income fund (senior-secured private credit, US/Europe mid-market), equipment leasing and real estate funds; real estate (local and international) and direct investment teams.

islamic_wealth.detail: Entire bank is Sharia-compliant: Islamic money market funds (KWD/USD), Islamic income fund, sukuk for PB/Royal clients, Shariah-compliant deposits.

partners.what: UX/UI assessment benchmarking Warba's mobile app across Kuwait and the GCC (2025 annual report)

initiatives.what: Acquired Warba Strategy Company (formerly Al Ghanem Trading), owner of 32.75% of Gulf Bank; signed an MoU with Gulf Bank and appointed advisers to study a merger into one Sharia-compliant bank (CBK acknowledgment 15 Jun 2025)

Launched second series of flagship Islamic income fund (private credit); marketed Shariah-compliant funds and sukuk to Private and Royal Banking clients; opened Shamiya and Saad Al-Abdullah branches (21 total) with a Royal section at Shamiya

Management restructuring into two sectors: Treasury & Investment (Thuwaini Al-Thuwaini named Acting Deputy CEO) and Digital Transformation, Operations & Business Development (Anwar Al-Ghaith, Deputy CEO); pending regulatory approvals at the time

opportunities: The investment-management page lists a digital trading platform with direct access to local, regional and international markets as 'Coming Soon' (S5). That is a live build-or-buy point for digital investing.
Fiduciary assets grew from KWD 620.9m (Jun 2025) to KWD 860.5m (Jun 2026) (S3), and AUM was up ~33% in 2025 (S4).
Strong AI push in client tools (Warba Advisor 2024 with investment recommendations; Bdr AI agentic assistant Jul 2026) under Deputy CEO Digital Transformation & Operations Anwar Al Ghaith (S9).
Royal (KD 100k-400k) and Private Banking segments are being offered funds and sukuk (S7, S4).
barriers: Islamic-only bank: every product and portfolio must be Shariah-compliant and approved by its Sharia Supervisory Board (S3 note 1).
A potential merger with Gulf Bank (32.75% owned; due diligence nearing completion in May 2026) may delay new vendor decisions or change the decision-maker (S3, S12).
An in-house investment management unit manufactures funds and runs mandates, so it may prefer its own products (S2, S5).
incumbent_vendors: No named wealth or trading technology vendor found. 11:FS ran a mobile-app UX assessment (S4).
